name: Gandesa (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with a white left glove, palm outward.
history: The official flag of Gandesa is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, purple, with the white left glove of the arms, palm outward, centred on the cloth, of height 2/3 of the cloth; approved by the municipal council on 9 February 2023, by the Department of the Presidency on 26 July 2023 and published in the DOGC.

features.role: left glove, palm outward, at the centre
